caption: Figure 4.46: This ﬁgure shall illustrate what kind of ExecutableEntity will run in what order during an asynchronous mode transition where the ExecutableEntities are triggered on a mode change are mapped to a higher priority task than the Mode Dependent ExecutableEntity. The boxes indicate activated ExecutableEntity. Mode disabling dependant ExecutableEntity are printed in blue (old mode) and pink (new mode). OnExit, OnTransition, and OnEntry ExecutableEntity are printed in red, yellow, and green.
